contents.reason: The page keeps the explicit exterior-ball and exterior-cone barrier criteria rather than minting a second immediate geometric solvability corollary. Any convex-domain application is a one-line use of the included barrier criteria and does not need its own scaffold item here.

contents.name: Corollary 11.13 (a bounded domain with C^2 boundary has a solvable Dirichlet problem)
contents.reason: This is another immediate geometric solvability corollary of the included barrier criteria, but it imports a separate smooth-boundary vocabulary that the page does not otherwise need. The explicit disc and cone criteria are the designed geometric endpoints here.
